permissions.title: A few permissions
permissions.subtitle: Kawa needs these to work well
permissions.locationDesc: KAWA uses your real-time location to find nearby verified scrap collectors (Kabadiwalas), calculate distances, and set your pickup point on the map.
permissions.cameraDesc: Take photos of your scrap items (paper, metal, e-waste, plastics) so collectors can inspect materials before pickup. Also used by Officers for document verification.
permissions.notifDesc: Receive immediate updates when a Kabadiwala accepts your request, arrives at your doorstep, or when scrap collection is verified.
permissions.summaryDesc: You are all set to explore Kawa. You can adjust permissions anytime in App Settings.

safety.title: E-Waste Safety Hub
safety.subtitle: Safe handling guidance for informal collectors & aggregators
safety.noBurnCableTitle: Never Burn Wires in Open Air
safety.noBurnCableDesc: Burning cables releases carcinogenic dioxins, destroys copper purity, and lowers your sale price.
safety.noAcidDesc: Using nitric/cyanide acids causes lethal respiratory damage and severe groundwater contamination.
safety.noBreakCrtDesc: Vacuum implosion scatters toxic phosphor dust and heavy lead particles.
safety.noPunctureBatteryDesc: Damaged or shorted lithium-ion cells cause instant thermal runaway fires and explosions.
safety.safeHandoverDesc: Deliver intact items to authorized recyclers for certified weights, highest prices, and EPR receipts.
